structure_plan.overview: Small 6x6 white house centered on an 8x8 light-bluish-gray base, with a black recessed door, 1x1 trans-clear windows, a blue shed-style sloped roof, and a small red chimney plus a tiny front porch/doormat.

subassemblies.name: Base + Porch
subassemblies.description: 8x8 LBG plate base with a small front porch pad and short path.

subassemblies.name: Wall Box
subassemblies.description: White 6x6 walls, 4 bricks tall, with a 2-stud-wide front door opening and small trans-clear windows on sides/back.

subassemblies.name: Roof + Chimney
subassemblies.description: Blue shed roof made from 2x2 and 2x1 slopes, plus a small red chimney stack with a tile cap.

subassemblies.name: Details
subassemblies.description: Windowsills, doormat, and simple eave trim using tiles.

step_outline.title: Base (8x8)
step_outline.description: Assemble an 8x8 base using LBG plates 3020 (2x4) x4 (or equivalent mix of LBG plates).

step_outline.title: Front porch pad
step_outline.description: At the front-center edge, add a 4x2 porch using White plates 3020 (2x4) x1 cut to 4x2 with 3023 (1x2) x2; add White corner plates 2420 x2 at the front corners for a rounded porch silhouette.

step_outline.title: Floor footprint (6x6)
step_outline.description: Center a 6x6 floor on the base using White plates (mix 3021/3020/3022/3023). Leave 1-stud margin on left/right and back; porch connects to front edge.

step_outline.title: Walls layer 1 (door opening)
step_outline.description: Build White brick perimeter for a 6x6 house using 3004/3003/3002/3001, leaving a 2-stud-wide front-center door opening. Add Black bricks 3004/3003 one stud back inside the opening to suggest a recessed door.

step_outline.title: Walls layer 2 (windows)
step_outline.description: On each side wall, add a 2-wide window: place TransClear tiles 3062b x2 at eye level, framed by White bricks 3004 around them. Add one similar 2-wide window on the back wall.

step_outline.title: Walls layer 3 (lintels)
step_outline.description: Raise all walls one brick layer higher in White. Over the door opening, span a White brick 3010 (1x4) or 3001 (2x4) as a lintel (centered).

step_outline.title: Walls layer 4 + top tie
step_outline.description: Add the 4th brick layer in White to complete wall height. Cap the wall perimeter with a White plate ring (mix 3023/3024/3022) to lock the box.

step_outline.title: Roof support (shed slope)
step_outline.description: At the back edge only, add one extra White brick layer (height +1) across the full 6-stud width, then cap it with White plates to form the higher roof bearing line.

step_outline.title: Roof row 1 (back)
step_outline.description: Place Blue slopes across the 6-stud width, oriented sloping down toward the front: per row use 3039 (2x2 slope) x2 + 3040 (2x1 slope) x2 to total 6 studs wide.

step_outline.title: Roof row 2 (middle)
step_outline.description: Add the second roof row (same parts/orientation): Blue 3039 x2 + Blue 3040 x2.

step_outline.title: Roof row 3 (front)
step_outline.description: Add the third roof row (same parts/orientation): Blue 3039 x2 + Blue 3040 x2. Add a thin front eave trim using White tiles 3069b (1x2) along the front edge if studs allow.

step_outline.title: Chimney
step_outline.description: On the back-left roof area, stack Red bricks (e.g., 3004 x2 + 3003 x1) into a 2x2-ish chimney and cap with a Red tile 3068b (2x2) or Red plate 3022 (2x2).

step_outline.title: Windowsills + doormat
step_outline.description: Under each window, add White tiles 3069b (1x2) as sills. On the porch, place a Red tile 3069b (1x2) centered as a doormat.

step_outline.title: Front path
step_outline.description: Add a short LBG path from porch to base edge using LBG tiles 3069b (1x2) x2–3 or LBG plates 3023 if tiles are tight.

notes: Color blocking: Walls White, base/path LBG, roof Blue, chimney Red, door recess Black, windows TransClear.
Roof uses exactly 3 rows: total Blue 3039 x6 and Blue 3040 x6. If short, substitute any available slope colors or reduce to 2 rows (shorter depth).
If you prefer a larger base, extend with extra LBG plates; keep the 6x6 wall box centered for the same silhouette.
